text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"extended personal example about being bullied and changing after talking to a friend and mother","quality":"development","description":"The essay elaborates its ideas with a sustained example that gives the writing more substance and explanation."},{"evidence":"connected ideas across paragraphs with transitions like \"That really changed me\" and \"That's why\"","quality":"coherence","description":"The essay organizes its points into a clearer line of thought from problem to reflection to conclusion."},{"evidence":"sentences such as \"There should be more help in this world\" and \"People should start teaching there kids early on\"","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"The essay expands on its main claim with multiple supporting remarks rather than short list-like statements."},{"evidence":"phrases like \"live your life to the fullest\" and \"the greatest accomplishment\"","quality":"expression","description":"The essay shows stronger ability to express a reflective, persuasive tone with more natural-sounding language."},{"evidence":"uses linking language like \"But one day,\" \"A few weeks passed,\" and \"Also\"","quality":"sentence flow","description":"The essay has smoother progression between sentences and ideas, which makes it easier to follow."}]}
